summary: KonaTel filed an 8-K disclosing that, effective October 30, 2026, its transfer agent Pacific Stock Transfer moved 98,600 common shares held by 490 record holders as unclaimed property to the Texas Comptroller, Account 8516-7296; the shares were originally issued 1986–1988. The company also intends to file a Form 15 to deregister under the Exchange Act after post-effective amendments withdraw 5,850,000 unissued S-8 shares, and to apply for OTCID Tier alternative reporting to save roughly $250,000 annually. Watch execution timing, OTCID approval, and reduced disclosure/liquidity risk.
